nodes.text: His mind was enraged against them.
a prophet whom he had in his land.
He offered him so much treasure
if he would come to him
those whom God himself led and cared for,
so that by the spell of the curse
then he could win all the better.
For that reason he sent for the prophet.
He promised him treasure in plenty
if he would come to his help with counsel.
